title: Hofkirche Innsbruck Schwarz-Mander
highlights: Bedeutendstes Kaisergrabmal Europas von Kaiser Maximilian I.
28 lebensgrosse überlebensgrosse Bronzefiguren der Schwarzen Mander
Historische Ebert-Orgel aus dem Jahr 1558 als funktionierendes Klangdenkmal
Grabstätte des Tiroler Freiheitskämpfers Andreas Hofer
kurzbeschreibung: The Hofkirche Innsbruck houses the world-famous Renaissance cenotaph of Kaiser Maximilian I. with 28 larger-than-life bronze statues.
beschreibung:
Imperial Renaissance Monument

The Hofkirche Innsbruck, affectionately known locally as the Schwarz-Mander-Kirche, is home to one of Europe's most magnificent artistic monuments. Kaiser Ferdinand I. commissioned the three-aisled hall church between 1553 and 1563 as a memorial for his grandfather, Kaiser Maximilian I.

The Schwarzen Mander and Andreas Hofer

The monumental marble cenotaph is flanked by 28 larger-than-life bronze figures, including mythical and historical ancestors of Maximilian such as König Artus and Gottfried von Bouillon. In addition, the church holds the tomb of the Tyrolean freedom fighter Andreas Hofer and his companions.
